outcome: comorbid diagnosis of a postpartum sleep disorder and depression
cohort: The study included commercially insured women who delivered in California, USA, between 2011 and 2014.
finding: Postpartum sleep disorders are underdiagnosed, affecting 2% of postpartum women in this cohort, with insomnia being the most common disorder and one-third of diagnosed women also having depression.
followup_time: up to 12 months following hospital discharge
